The [[Vanguard Pet Master]] is a [[pet tamer]], a type of [[Non-player character|NPC]] who allows players to remove their current [[Animal companion|pet]] in order to gain a new one.

==Locations==
*[[Far Shiverpeaks]]
**{{NPC location|Ice Cliff Chasms}} (in [[Gwen's garden]])

==Dialogue==
''"You might consider me something of an animal lover. I've trekked across [[Tyria]] and bargained with adventurers from distant lands to acquire my menagrie of creatures, especially the exotic ones. Say, you look like the adventuring type. You don't happen you'd like me to see, would you?"''
:'''"What do you do with the animals you collect?"'''
:''"While some of the creatures I acquire get shipped to wealthy patrons in Cantha, I can't help but keep some of them for my own personal collection. I have such a fondness for the furry, the feathery, and the scaly. Nothing quite beats waking up in the morning to the howling of a magnificent wolf!"''
::'''"I'd like to think it over some more."'''
:'''"Do you have any interest in my pet?"''' (If you have a pet)
:(Level 20 pet charmed in the wild)
:''"This animal is quite unique! I will gladly pay you 100 gold to part with it. Just keep in mind that once we do this, your pet will never be returned."'' 
::'''"{{yes}}Yes, I would be happy to leave my pet in your capable hands."''' (Lose pet, gain 100{{gold}})
::'''"I'd like to think it over some more."'''
:(Lower level pet or pet charmed in the Zaishen Menagerie)
